blocks.text: Avril Lavigne—the princess of pop-punk — has a new title: mom. The eight-time Grammy Award-nominated singer-songwriter revealed on Instagram on Friday, Nov. 13, that she has welcomed her first child, a baby girl. “Our mini princess has arrived,” she wrote, using an expletive for emphasis. The 42-year-old new mother posted three images: She and her presumed partner holding their baby’s hand, Lavigne sweetly holding the infant to her chest and a skateboard with two adult-size, checkered Vans beside a pair of baby Vans. Lavigne has not revealed her partner’s identity or the baby’s name. View this post on Instagram A post shared by […]...
